So I looked up reviews and thought about it and bought it. One of the essential functions for a dishwasher is hot air drying and automatic door opening, and this model has both functions, and it is a model with UV, so it is so great. However, please note that the dishes are not completely dry even after hot air drying. And there is no function to run only drying or only UV separately. However, the price covers all of this! Sentence (English): This is a good dishwasher~!
Comments (English): This is a good dishwasher~! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher is a product that combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a cost-effective dishwasher that is especially suitable for a family of 3-4. When I actually used it, I was more satisfied than I thought, and I personally felt why dishwashers are called 'essential home appliances' these days. The first thing that catches my eye is the simple and modern design. The metallic exterior with a stainless steel feel goes well anywhere in the kitchen, and the simple front display is intuitive to use. All operations can be easily performed with the top touch panel, and the various washing courses are well-divided, so even first-time users can use it without difficulty. This product is a large-capacity 12-person model, so it has the great advantage of being able to wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially liked the fact that it can hold large kitchenware such as pots, frying pans, and cutting boards, so there is no hassle of washing dishes two or three times. The inner basket has a two-tier structure with upper and lower sections, and knives, ladles, spoons, etc. can be neatly arranged in separate spaces, making excellent use of space. The cleaning power was also better than expected. Soup bowls, oily frying pans, dried rice, etc. were cleaned to a sparkling clean finish, and when detergent and rinse aid were used together, glass cups and stainless steel dishes were finished to a glossy finish. It is also equipped with a high-temperature sterilization function, so it is safe in terms of hygiene, and it was especially useful when washing baby dishes or cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a regular washing machine, and it was not too bothersome because it was at the level of everyday noise even when running at night. The energy efficiency is also satisfactory, so the electricity bill was not a big burden even when used frequently, and water usage is much less than that of a regular washing machine, so it can be said to be a product that takes both the environment and economy into consideration. There was no particular difficulty in terms of installation. Basic installation is very simple, and if it is in an environment where water connection is difficult, separate installation service or installation using a mobile drain is also possible. However, since it is a freestanding type and not a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and prior measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand, and is famous for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice as a practical product for beginners or those who fit the budget, as it has sufficient functions for the price and high satisfaction with actual use. In particular, it was impressive that there was no significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model focusing on cost-effectiveness'. Sentence (English): Have likes and dislikes about this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Nice Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Have likes and dislikes about this dishwasher. Have owned several Whirlpool dishwashers since the 1980s and have always liked the interal rack design and features. This dishwasher comes with a third rack which I like. The utensil basket has be moved from the door to the bottom rack and I prefer the door location. Provided more capacity for dishes. Had no problem getting the utensils clean as long as no large object was placed directly in front blocking the water spray. As long as the dishwasher was loaded properly every thing came out clean. The new dishwasher is very quiet and that is a big improvement. The panel on top of the door is OK, but not as easily accessible as the front panel. However, I do not like the bottom or middle rack designs. The dishwasher is much more difficult to load with wider spaces between bowls. I could load more dishes with the old racks. The change may prevent overcrowding but I never had that problem before, knowing the water must always be able to reach each dish.Overall, its a nice dishwasher.

It's turned what used to be a chore into something I barely think about anymore, and that, for me, is real luxury. Sentence (English): I love this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ All the bells and whistles at an affordable price ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher. I have only been using it for a few weeks, but these are the stand out elements: It is so quiet. I live in a townhouse and my lounge and dining are right on top of the kitchen. I can have the dishwasher on and it does not interfere with life being lived in the other spaces at all. It has heaps of room. The pull out cutlery tray (which I haven't been a fan of in the past), washes the cutlery exceptionally well and leaves far more room on the bottom shelf where a basket would have been. This dishwasher has all the fancy features of some of the very expensive ones I looked at but could not afford. It is fully digital with no extruding buttons or knobs. It has an Eco wash and a Quick wash. And best of all it has a Smart Dry feature which pops the door open for the drying time. I have never had dishes so dry after using a dishwasher. You can choose not to use this feature if you do not want your dishwasher door open. It has a wireless feature for remote control. I haven't used that yet but I imagine at some stage I will as I love this capacity on my air-con. I purchased this dishwasher on special for around $600, and when I consider all the features it has, if it had been an “elite” brand, it would have cost closer to $1000. So I am very happy and would highly recommend.

Sentence (English): My husband kept singing the praises of a dishwasher, but since I believe dishwashing should be done by hand, I didn't buy one.
Comments (English): [ I finally got it... My hesitation just delayed the delivery again. ] || ---------------- || My husband kept singing the praises of a dishwasher, but since I believe dishwashing should be done by hand, I didn't buy one. I tend to be very meticulous about washing dishes—they need to make a squeaky sound one by one, and I wash pots and pans two or three times—so doing the dishes once drains my energy and is exhausting. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I should have bought this sooner. The top 3 appliances my husband wanted and we ordered are: 1. Dryer, 2. Dishwasher, 3. Food Waste Disposer. Thank you, honey, for bringing the help. ---------Review after about 3 months of use------------. Suddenly, I wonder how on earth I ever lived without a dishwasher. For over 30 years, I lived believing that dishes had to be washed by hand, but now washing dishes by hand feels unsanitary. That is how clean and fluffy the hot dishes come out of the dishwasher, completely dried. Being able to use dishes to my heart's content without worrying about the pile of dishes, plus not having to worry even when guests come over and I bring out a ton of dishes. Even if the sink is piled high, I can put everything into the dishwasher, and seeing the empty sink makes me feel truly happy. I guess that's why people say you should definitely buy the big one. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I should have bought this sooner. The top 3 appliances my husband wanted and we ordered are: 1. Dryer, 2. Dishwasher, 3. Food Waste Disposer. Thank you, honey, for bringing the help. ---------Review after about 3 months of use------------. Suddenly, I wonder how on earth I ever lived without a dishwasher. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. My hesitation just delayed the delivery again. ] || ---------------- || My husband kept singing the praises of a dishwasher, but since I believe dishwashing should be done by hand, I didn't buy one. I tend to be very meticulous about washing dishes—they need to make a squeaky sound one by one, and I wash pots and pans two or three times—so doing the dishes once drains my energy and is exhausting. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I should have bought this sooner. The top 3 appliances my husband wanted and we ordered are: 1. Dryer, 2. Dishwasher, 3. Food Waste Disposer. Thank you, honey, for bringing the help. ---------Review after about 3 months of use------------. Suddenly, I wonder how on earth I ever lived without a dishwasher. For over 30 years, I lived believing that dishes had to be washed by hand, but now washing dishes by hand feels unsanitary. That is how clean and fluffy the hot dishes come out of the dishwasher, completely dried. Being able to use dishes to my heart's content without worrying about the pile of dishes, plus not having to worry even when guests come over and I bring out a ton of dishes. Even if the sink is piled high, I can put everything into the dishwasher, and seeing the empty sink makes me feel truly happy. I guess that's why people say you should definitely buy the big one. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. My hesitation just delayed the delivery again. ] || ---------------- || My husband kept singing the praises of a dishwasher, but since I believe dishwashing should be done by hand, I didn't buy one. I tend to be very meticulous about washing dishes—they need to make a squeaky sound one by one, and I wash pots and pans two or three times—so doing the dishes once drains my energy and is exhausting. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I should have bought this sooner. The top 3 appliances my husband wanted and we ordered are: 1. Dryer, 2. Dishwasher, 3. Food Waste Disposer. Thank you, honey, for bringing the help. ---------Review after about 3 months of use------------. Suddenly, I wonder how on earth I ever lived without a dishwasher. For over 30 years, I lived believing that dishes had to be washed by hand, but now washing dishes by hand feels unsanitary. That is how clean and fluffy the hot dishes come out of the dishwasher, completely dried. Being able to use dishes to my heart's content without worrying about the pile of dishes, plus not having to worry even when guests come over and I bring out a ton of dishes. Even if the sink is piled high, I can put everything into the dishwasher, and seeing the empty sink makes me feel truly happy. I guess that's why people say you should definitely buy the big one. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

My hesitation just delayed the delivery again. ] || ---------------- || My husband kept singing the praises of a dishwasher, but since I believe dishwashing should be done by hand, I didn't buy one. I tend to be very meticulous about washing dishes—they need to make a squeaky sound one by one, and I wash pots and pans two or three times—so doing the dishes once drains my energy and is exhausting. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. I should have bought this sooner. The top 3 appliances my husband wanted and we ordered are: 1. Dryer, 2. Dishwasher, 3. Food Waste Disposer. Thank you, honey, for bringing the help. ---------Review after about 3 months of use------------. Suddenly, I wonder how on earth I ever lived without a dishwasher. For over 30 years, I lived believing that dishes had to be washed by hand, but now washing dishes by hand feels unsanitary. That is how clean and fluffy the hot dishes come out of the dishwasher, completely dried. Being able to use dishes to my heart's content without worrying about the pile of dishes, plus not having to worry even when guests come over and I bring out a ton of dishes. Even if the sink is piled high, I can put everything into the dishwasher, and seeing the empty sink makes me feel truly happy. I guess that's why people say you should definitely buy the big one. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

I tend to be very meticulous about washing dishes—they need to make a squeaky sound one by one, and I wash pots and pans two or three times—so doing the dishes once drains my energy and is exhausting. I added it to my cart and agonized over it again and again. I hate having someone else do the dishes for me, and I hate doing them myself. They pile up every day, and trying to do them all at once is even harder. Sometimes when my husband helps, I stand next to him and act like a nuisance, asking him to scrub harder. So, he asked for a dishwasher as a birthday present, and for the sake of domestic peace, I bought it. My quality of life has improved since the very first day it arrived. I'm not the type to compare features one by one, so I just picked the newest model that was the most expensive before any discounts. To install a dishwasher, you need space of approximately 600 x 600 x 820 mm (width x depth x height). Since our kitchen cabinet is 800 mm, I contacted Coupang Customer Service to inquire about installation feasibility before placing the order. I was advised to choose a dishwasher model with "due" in front of the model name since my baseboard is 15cm. I had the installation done the next day, and the technician was very kind and skilled. Thank you for doing it on such a hot day. The 600 model dishwasher fits into the 800 cabinet, and for the remaining space, they made a two-tiered side cabinet. They mentioned that since the sink cabinet height is higher than the dishwasher, they aligned the bottom line to leave a slight gap at the top, and I am very satisfied! After putting in the 1kg of salt, rinse aid, and all-in-one detergent I had prepared in advance, I ran the one-hour cycle with one hour of hot air. Midway through, the door opened, so I wondered what was going on and closed it again, only for it to open again. It turned out it opened to dry. It is so quiet that I had to put my ear right up to it; the noise level is zero. I ran the dishwasher in the evening, and seeing the empty sink in the morning made me so happy. It has lots of features, is easy to operate, and is just so good. Seriously, my aunt approves.

First of all, the True Steam function is really good. It makes glasses sparkle without any cloudy water marks. It also sterilizes, so it is especially reassuring for families with children. If there is a downside, it is that I have to fix the bottom of the sink a bit when installing it? Since it is a built-in product, if the structure doesn't fit, I have to fix it a bit, but fortunately, it fits well in the existing oven space in my house. And if you open the door right after washing, the heat inside will rise quite a bit, so be careful. In summary, it sterilizes well. It washes cleanly without water stains. Above all, it greatly reduces the stress of childcare and housework. A lot of people around me ask about it, but I am really satisfied with it, so I confidently recommend it!

Sentence (English): I am not sure what the worst thing is, but the panel is truly terrible.
Comments (English): [ Awful dishwasher for the price ] || ---------------- || I am not sure what the worst thing is, but the panel is truly terrible. It is not very responsive, it doesn't have actual buttons just a flat sensor screen and doesn't always register when you press buttons. It doesn't have many buttons so figuring out how to turn it on and off, reset it, or interrupt a cycle is stupidly complex. It does have a phone app that I haven't used. The third rack is useless and too small for anything to fit, yet it takes up too much space to put large glasses in the glasses tray below it. The bottom rack is laid out so weird, it's as if the person who designed it didn't know what dishes are and just put racks in randomly. Even though it's got 3 racks, it's hard to fit normal things in there because the rack layout is so weird. It would work if you only wash plates. Washing bowls is ridiculous because they don't actually fit anyplace. And the arm comes down so low you can't wash anything tall because it'll hit the arm. If I don't turn on the heated dry, dishes are still wet when I open the dishwasher the next day which is a great breeding ground for bacteria. The full cycle takes 2-3h to run. This thing drinks through rinse aid like a fish which is annoying, and instructions say that it doesn't work well without it so that's another requirement. Finally, about half the time my dishes come out smelling like eggs. I've had plumbers, electricians, and appliance repair people here and the consensus is just that this is how the dishwasher works. It is quiet. But I would trade the quiet for a freight train if it would just work properly. I can't stress how much I regret buying this thing. I've had it less than a year and I've wasted so much time and money already, just for it to be barely functional. It's my first Bosch appliance and I won't buy any more.

Sentence (English): Originally, I wanted to buy a 12-person built-in dishwasher if I had more space.
Comments (English): [ The quality of life has improved and it is quiet even when turned on at night. ] || ---------------- || Originally, I wanted to buy a 12-person built-in dishwasher if I had more space. It’s so tiring to cook and wash dishes after work. A large-capacity built-in model was so attractive, but unfortunately, there was no room for that size in my kitchen. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. I can use it without worrying even after eating late at night, and I don’t have to worry about the noise, so my stress has been greatly reduced. It saves water and washes much more cleanly than hand washing. The drying function is also good, so although there is some moisture left, it is satisfying that it finishes with a feeling of drying for more than half a day, and it is also useful that there are various washing modes so you can choose according to the situation. However, when you tip over a dish, the concave part or the place where water can collect remains wet even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish. The installer came kindly and carefully determined the location for the kitchen, told me how to check if water is leaking from the faucet later, and explained the machine well, so I felt good from the installation. 6/14 Added It splashed a little while cutting kimchi, but it was erased cleanly when I quickly wiped it with a wet tissue. 7/8 Added I don't use a separate rinse, but I only use detergent, and there are some white water stains, but it's not a problem, so I'm just using it. There is no significant problem with the cleaning power~ Overall review: Sufficient capacity for a family of two (enough to wash dishes for one or two meals) It is very quiet, so you can use it at night without any worries The bespoke white design is luxurious and goes well with the kitchen interior. Easy to install and the technician was kind. Satisfied with both the cleaning power and drying power! I don't have to wash the dishes by hand, so my quality of life has definitely improved. So after much thought, I chose this Samsung Bespoke countertop 6-person dishwasher. To be honest, at first I was worried whether it would be okay for 6 people, but after using it, I’m satisfied because it can handle one or two meals for a family of two. The design is neat and luxurious, and the white color brightens up the kitchen atmosphere, and the Bespoke’s unique minimal and sophisticated design really matches the interior. It’s a bit bigger than I thought, but if you secure a little installation space, I think anyone can use it without any problems. The best part is that it makes very little noise when washing. However, when you tip over a dish, the concave part or the place where water can collect remains wet even after washing. It would be easier if you tilt the dish. It is the best appliance that catches two birds with one stone: a pretty kitchen and easy dishwashing!

Sentence (English): The installer took into consideration the space and the route and moved the shelves, so he installed it perfectly.
Comments (English): [ It's cost effective and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || The installer took into consideration the space and the route and moved the shelves, so he installed it perfectly. He was sensible and kind, just like a large company. I had been looking at built-ins for a while because I live alone, but I don't cook that much, and when I moved to a bigger house, I wanted to buy a 12-person large company. For now, I decided to buy a 6-person product that is white + the slimmest + the most cost-effective, so I decided on Mydia. These days, there are many products without windows, but I personally wanted to see inside while it was being washed, so I chose one with a window. However, my baby likes to look at the window more than I do. To be honest, the hot air drying function is weak, but I am satisfied because I knew it well. I will have more free time in the evening. The downside is that Coupang's customer service side is inflexible and only repeats the answer that Coupang Safe Care is absolutely not an additional purchase. If I already got it installed and want a 5-year warranty, do I have to return it through the technician and pay again to have it installed? Isn't that too inefficient? It's not an unreasonable request, and if it's a service that customers who purchase it want, please improve the regulations a bit.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 좋고 세척도 잘 돼요 ] || ---------------- || 설치기사님이 공간과 동선을 고려하여 선반도 옮겨 달아주실 정도로 완벽하게 잘 설치해주고 가셨습니다. 센스있고 대기업 못지않게 친절하셨어요. 자가라서 빌트인을 한동안 눈여겨 보고 있었는데, 요리를 그렇게 많이 하는 편도 아니고, 좀 더 넓은 집으로 이사가게 됐을 때 대기업 12인용을 하고 싶었어요. 일단 지금은 6인용 중 무조건 화이트 색상 + 제일 슬림하고 + 제일 가성비 좋은 제품을 사기로 해서 마이디어로 결정했습니다.  요즘은 창이 없는 제품들이 많던데, 저는 개인적으로 세척되고 있는 안을 살펴보고 싶어서 굳이 창이 있는 것으로 했어요. 그런데 저보단 아기가 저 창을 구경하는걸 되게 좋아하네요ㅋㅋ  솔직히 열풍건조 기능이 약하긴 하지만 익히 알고 있던터라 만족합니다. 저녁 시간에 좀 더 여유가 생기겠네요.  단점은 융통성 없이 쿠팡안심케어 절대절대 추가구매 안된다는 답변만 반복하는 쿠팡 고객의소리측. 이미 설치받았는데 5년 보증받고 싶으면 굳이 기사님 통해 반품했다가 다시 결제해서 설치받으란 소린가.. 너무 비효율적이지 않나요? 무리한 요구도 아니고 구매한 고객이 충분히 원할만한 서비스는 규정을 좀 개선하세요.

Sentence (English): We had to replace our 9 1/2 year old GE Profile 47 db dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Worst Option Available - DO NOT BUY This model ] || ---------------- || We had to replace our 9 1/2 year old GE Profile 47 db dishwasher. We bought this model SHP65CM5N on May 13, but did not get it delivered and installed until May 17. We had done our research and based on quietest 44db and filtration we thought we were getting the right system for us. This is Not the case! From the first test wash, we noticed it seemed louder than our old unit, but hey let's give it go! 2 months later! Here we are! Loading this washer is a task. Only the 3rd rack is easy! Spacing and angles of rack tongs makes it very difficult to load. The wine glass tip up rack is useless! Trying to load larger items like casserole dishes or platter's is almost not possible! Trying to load tupperware in second or bottom rack is cumbersome as the rack/tongs are all angled and to close together. These racks are good for only dishes and smaller items! The bottom rack holds a ridiculous small utensil tray that flips open in wrong direction so very difficult to load larger items utensils (beaters, etc). Thank goodness we kept old GE utensil tray to hold those larger items! Drying? It says it has Pure Dry, so we thought a drying system! NOPE! It's supposedly uses the heat from steam/water to dry dishes! Hahaha! Nope. Then they promoted the Auto-Air Dry! LOL. The door pops open to allow your plastics to dry! NOT! Our old 9 1/2 year old GE washer dried WAY better! Washing! Small shallow items in top 3rd row do come out clean unless they are well rinsed! Then the quietness! 44 db vs 47 (old). When the washer is running its normal cycle - WOW! loud. We can hear water spraying against door! Versus our old dishwasher where we heard nothing! People would always open the door during cycle because you couldn't hear anything! This has been a huge disappointment! Thought we were buying one of the best washers and we should have bought a Kitchen Aid or Maytag! German design? The rinse agent dispenser sucks through a ton fluid. Have filled it 3 times in 2 months! Our old GE washer way better washer. The only 2 good options seem to be the top 3rd drawer! And how the soap dispenses. We Do NOT recommend this Bosch Dishwasher! RUN ….

Sentence (English): The interior layout of both the upper and lower racks is positively terrible.
Comments (English): [ Terrible interior layout ] || ---------------- || The interior layout of both the upper and lower racks is positively terrible. The designers seemed to have a specific subset of dishes in mind. If you have this subset, great! Otherwise you'll likely struggle to get dishes and glasses aligned properly. My old Maytag could fit 24 glasses and mugs on the top rack and still have room for long utensils. This thing can only fit about 20 glasses total, it struggles with standard mugs, and there is no extra room for long utensils. The bottom rack has tines that are too close together and aren't even aligned from the back rows to the front. This means that long items like cookie trays don't easily fit. It is also impossible to get deep bowls to fit unless you have a specific type of bowl. The silverware rack is also useless. Note that as of this review, the images Lowes is using are from the older model (The /36 and earlier). Bosch redesigned the interior and with it changed the silverware rack to a rectangle that takes up space in the bottom rack. The layout of at least the bottom rack is also different than what is shown. (My model is a /38)All in all, avoid this one. It will only draw your frustration at how poorly it is laid out.

Bad if we don't want our house to be bathed in red light for hours while it is running. The bad:-no physical buttons. I'm going to have to read 23844 pages of documentation to determine this, and then experiment. Not everything needs an app and connection to the internet. Honestly now I'm going to worry about someone hacking my dishwasher. -the layout is different from my old Bosch and I don't like it as much (subjective, I I know). It doesn't seem as efficient, and the options are less flexible. The cups don't fit as well in the top rack. I'm willing to learn to load my stuff differently so maybe this will improve over time but I suspect it will not.-The racks seem flimsier. They don't roll as smoothly and they feel like they could be easily snapped by too heavy a load or a clumsy child. -The silverware basket is shallower and seems like it takes up more room.Had I realized there were so many changes, I might have tried to salvage my aged former Bosch. I purchased what I thought was the same basic model that we had before - a Bosch 500 - since we had loved it so much and it has been great for our family of five (we loved it so much that we renovated our kitchen and kept it rather than buying a new appliance). The good:-Costco installer was great. He came, did the job in our slightly more complex set up, cleaned up, and left in record time. Was quiet and courteous.-Costco - I just love the company so much, I'm glad to buy this product through them. -has a built in salt reservoir for water softening. I like this bc our water is hard but we don't have a whole house softener. -The third rack has a nice drop feature that allows you to independently have sides higher or lower to variously accommodate tall glasses on the second rack or deeper containers on the third rack. As a mom of kids with a million fiddly lunch containers I appreciate this flexibility.-The dishes have come out squeaky clean which is the goal-The wash cycle is very quiet. The drain cycle is obscene (imagine the death gargle of a giant squid or something) Things I am still not sure about:-the running light is extremely bright and red. When I walked into my kitchen last night I was concerned a volcano was erupting. It is bright. That is good if I want to know whether my dishwasher is on from across my house, or from space. Bad if we don't want our house to be bathed in red light for hours while it is running. The bad:-no physical buttons. This did not stand out to me when looking online or I would have considered other options. And there is no display. So, you can't open your dishwasher mid cycle and know where you are in the process. It is hard to push in the right spot on the control panel to make selections and if your fingers are wet the touch doesn't register. -connectivity and an app are required to use basic features like delay start and to see how long the cycle is. You have to go through an endless cycle of customized options to just get to a delayed start and you have to set it to be permanent, but it not clear if that means the thing will start itself every night or if I need to make the selection nightly . I'm going to have to read 23844 pages of documentation to determine this, and then experiment. Somehow my former wash cycle of 2:09 ballooned to 2:40 based on my selections when programming the app. Please just give me a connectivity free appliance with buttons! Not everything needs an app and connection to the internet. Honestly now I'm going to worry about someone hacking my dishwasher. -the layout is different from my old Bosch and I don't like it as much (subjective, I I know). It doesn't seem as efficient, and the options are less flexible. The cups don't fit as well in the top rack. I'm willing to learn to load my stuff differently so maybe this will improve over time but I suspect it will not.-The racks seem flimsier. They don't roll as smoothly and they feel like they could be easily snapped by too heavy a load or a clumsy child. -The silverware basket is shallower and seems like it takes up more room.Had I realized there were so many changes, I might have tried to salvage my aged former Bosch. And I might update this if the new Bosch endears itself to me over time. But just based on the app frustrations alone, I am regretting this purchase. Bosch, please stop the apps! Give us the buttons!

Sentence (English): My finger joints hurt and my shoulder pain got worse, so I ended up buying a dishwasher because it was so hard to wash dishes.

After installing and using it, I really wondered why I bought it now. Its compact size is not a burden even in a small kitchen, and its clean and sophisticated design matches well with the interior. What I especially liked was that it had strong cleaning power. It washes pots, glass bowls, and frying pans cleanly. It is strong in cleaning glass containers. Even glass lunch boxes, which I use frequently like Glasslock, are cleaned without any scratches! It brings out the luster of stainless steel. Pots and dishes that I could never wash by hand are now shiny and shiny. Automatic door opening function The door opens automatically after washing, so it dries naturally. Ample storage space Although it is for 6 people, you can put in a variety of dishes, pots, and glass bowls. In particular, since I prepare my husband's lunch box every day, there were many times when I couldn't wash the dishes in the morning, so it was hard to do it after work. It's really convenient to not put it off and just do it in small amounts and go to work. And I'm really satisfied because the glass lunch boxes and stainless steel that I use often are perfectly cleaned. At first, I was worried that it would take up space, but instead, the area around the sink became cleaner, and more than anything, the burden on my hands and shoulders was greatly reduced, so my quality of life improved. Comments (English): [ It's cost-effective and easy to clean. ] || ---------------- || The installer did a perfect job, even moving shelves around to accommodate the space and traffic flow. Many models don't have windows these days, but I personally prefer to see inside while the washer is being washed, so I opted for one with a window. Comments (English): [ Great, Quiet Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This is the Bosch 500 Stainless Steel Pocket Handle Dishwasher (rated at 44 dBA). If you're going to install it yourself there are a couple things to note (it's not difficult if you're fairly handy). First, older dishwashers were hard-wired, i.e., the electrical wire connected directly to the dishwasher, usually near the front behind the toe kick plate. Now, all the modern dishwashers that I've seen plug in, like garbage disposals. The Bosch comes with a cord for plugging in, so if your old dishwasher was hard-wired, you'll want to install a receptacle in the cabinet adjacent to where the dishwasher goes (much easier to plug in this way—see Photo 1). However, if you don't want (or know how) to install a receptacle, Bosch offers a junction box accessory (see Photo 2) that can be used instead. Next, if your dishwasher is not right next to your sink area, you'll probably need a drain hose extension (and possibly a water line extension). Figure this out before you take delivery of your dishwasher because the drain hose extension may not be locally available in your area (it wasn't in my area—Salt Lake City, UT). If you're not sure, order it with your dishwasher and, if you don't need it, you can probably return it. In my case, by me not having it on hand, it delayed my install by five days while I waited for one. My existing dishwasher did have a drain hose extension, but it was not compatible with the Bosch. The water line from your existing dishwasher should work fine. Newer dishwashers have an adapter that goes between the dishwasher and the water line (the water line is a standard connection—see Photo 3). Overall, the installation instructions supplied by Bosch are very good. There are also YouTube videos available if you need more help.The Bosch has three nice racks (see Photo 4)—the center one can be adjusted up and down as needed. We found that there was a lot of interior space for all kinds of dishes, pots, pans, flatware, bowls, etc. Cleaning ability is fantastic. My wife baked a casserole thingy (I'm not a cook so I don't know exactly what it was) in a stainless steel pan. This turned out to be a good test of the dishwasher. It was pretty disgusting when I put it in, but, it came out spotless, as did everything else I washed. Drying was very good too. One mug had water on the bottom but that was because I put it in flat and not angled as you're supposed to—my bad). Note that, the heating element in this unit is not exposed, which means you can put plastics (dishwasher safe, of course) in any rack. A nice touch. I also downloaded and connected the Bosch App (called Home Connect). It will tell you, among other things, current dishwasher status, how long until the dishwasher is done, and at what time. I really like that it sent me a notification when it was finished. Overall I think this is a great dishwasher.

Next, if your dishwasher is not right next to your sink area, you’ll probably need a drain hose extension (and possibly a water line extension). Sentence (English): Mixed Feelings – Great Cleaning, but Frustrating Controls We've had the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher for several months now.
Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 series dishwasher touchpad not always re ] || ---------------- || Mixed Feelings – Great Cleaning, but Frustrating Controls We've had the Bosch 800 Series dishwasher for several months now. While it does an excellent job cleaning dishes and runs very quietly, the touchpad interface has been a consistent source of frustration. Sometimes the touch controls don't respond at all, making it impossible to change the program. The only way we've found to fix it is by pressing and holding the power button for three seconds to reset the system. After that, it usually works again, but having to do this so frequently is not what I expected from a premium appliance. Second, the Home Connect app, which is supposed to let you control the dishwasher remotely, is a letdown. It requires you to create an account just to connect — why do I need to register and log in to control a dishwasher in my own home? It feels unnecessary and adds more hassle than convenience. Overall, the performance is solid, but the user experience is held back by an unreliable control panel.

Sentence (English): Reason for buying Media 12-person: Single-person household / I mostly order delivery and don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity.
Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-person media dishwasher instead of a 6-person one. ] || ---------------- || Reason for buying Media 12-person: Single-person household / I mostly order delivery and don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. There aren't many dishes, but I hate washing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days and do them all at once on holidays, so it's not hygienic and I feel exhausted because I wash them on holidays, so I don't feel like I've rested even when I rest, so I decided to buy a 6-person that I can use every day. However, the price of 6-person went up from a few months ago, so Cuckoo was 400,000 won to Samsung 600,000 won. In addition, the sink is small, so I have to buy a storage cabinet to put the dishwasher (average 200,000 won), so I expect to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Up until then, I didn't even consider Media 6-person even though it was cheaper. I wanted to buy a familiar brand. For this price, I'd rather buy LG 12-person for 700,000 won, so I looked into it because it has better cleaning power and I can handle large pots, and it was a built-in one without a drying or reservation function. Since I can't install a built-in one at my house, I can only use a freestanding one. I started looking into freestanding ones again, but Freestanding is 10-20 more expensive than built-in and doesn't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? The features that the LG 12-person model in the 700,000 won range doesn't have but the Media 12-person model does have 1. Drying function 2. Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. Instead, it has a 1/2 course that can be used when running a small amount! I can handle 3-4 dishes a day, so I'm satisfied because I can handle it every day without any burden. There's also a glass cup course that runs at low temperature, so it seems good for handling plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons 1. The noise is louder than I thought. It's about the same as the noise from a washing machine. They say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's the same level as the TV and the dishwasher. It's not a small noise that's buried in the TV. Instead, it has a reservation function, so I think I can run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble~ ----------> (After using it several times, I found that when I put in a small amount of dishes, the water stream hit the walls and ceiling, so it was loud, but on days when I put in a lot of dishes, it was quiet.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are wings only at the bottom and in the middle. But the cleaning power is good. 3. It was listed as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but it smells like a gas station when the drying function is on. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once but it was so bad that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it (if it were built-in, I would pay 30 more and buy the CUX Steam Shot). If you are looking for a 6-person dishwasher, I definitely recommend the 12-person one for the same price. If you are sensitive to Ascon issues, I don't recommend it. However, the price of 6-person went up from a few months ago, so Cuckoo was 400,000 won to Samsung 600,000 won. In addition, the sink is small, so I have to buy a storage cabinet to put the dishwasher (average 200,000 won), so I expect to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Up until then, I didn't even consider Media 6-person even though it was cheaper. I wanted to buy a familiar brand. For this price, I'd rather buy LG 12-person for 700,000 won, so I looked into it because it has better cleaning power and I can handle large pots, and it was a built-in one without a drying or reservation function. Since I can't install a built-in one at my house, I can only use a freestanding one. I started looking into freestanding ones again, but Freestanding is 10-20 more expensive than built-in and doesn't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? The features that the LG 12-person model in the 700,000 won range doesn't have but the Media 12-person model does have 1. Drying function 2. Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. Instead, it has a 1/2 course that can be used when running a small amount! I can handle 3-4 dishes a day, so I'm satisfied because I can handle it every day without any burden. There's also a glass cup course that runs at low temperature, so it seems good for handling plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons 1. The noise is louder than I thought. It's about the same as the noise from a washing machine. They say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's the same level as the TV and the dishwasher. It's not a small noise that's buried in the TV. Instead, it has a reservation function, so I think I can run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble~ ----------> (After using it several times, I found that when I put in a small amount of dishes, the water stream hit the walls and ceiling, so it was loud, but on days when I put in a lot of dishes, it was quiet.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are wings only at the bottom and in the middle. But the cleaning power is good. 3. It was listed as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but it smells like a gas station when the drying function is on. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once but it was so bad that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it (if it were built-in, I would pay 30 more and buy the CUX Steam Shot). The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy thinking that it is doing the dishes for me. After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. For this price, I'd rather buy LG 12-person for 700,000 won, so I looked into it because it has better cleaning power and I can handle large pots, and it was a built-in one without a drying or reservation function. Since I can't install a built-in one at my house, I can only use a freestanding one. I started looking into freestanding ones again, but Freestanding is 10-20 more expensive than built-in and doesn't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? The features that the LG 12-person model in the 700,000 won range doesn't have but the Media 12-person model does have 1. Drying function 2. Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. Instead, it has a 1/2 course that can be used when running a small amount! I can handle 3-4 dishes a day, so I'm satisfied because I can handle it every day without any burden. There's also a glass cup course that runs at low temperature, so it seems good for handling plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons 1. The noise is louder than I thought. It's about the same as the noise from a washing machine. They say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's the same level as the TV and the dishwasher. It's not a small noise that's buried in the TV. Instead, it has a reservation function, so I think I can run it in the morning and leave. Comments (English): [ Buy a 12-person media dishwasher instead of a 6-person one. ] || ---------------- || Reason for buying Media 12-person: Single-person household / I mostly order delivery and don't cook much, so I don't need a large capacity. There aren't many dishes, but I hate washing them, so I let them pile up for 3-4 days and do them all at once on holidays, so it's not hygienic and I feel exhausted because I wash them on holidays, so I don't feel like I've rested even when I rest, so I decided to buy a 6-person that I can use every day. However, the price of 6-person went up from a few months ago, so Cuckoo was 400,000 won to Samsung 600,000 won. In addition, the sink is small, so I have to buy a storage cabinet to put the dishwasher (average 200,000 won), so I expect to spend 600,000-800,000 won. Up until then, I didn't even consider Media 6-person even though it was cheaper. I wanted to buy a familiar brand. For this price, I'd rather buy LG 12-person for 700,000 won, so I looked into it because it has better cleaning power and I can handle large pots, and it was a built-in one without a drying or reservation function. Since I can't install a built-in one at my house, I can only use a freestanding one. I started looking into freestanding ones again, but Freestanding is 10-20 more expensive than built-in and doesn't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? The features that the LG 12-person model in the 700,000 won range doesn't have but the Media 12-person model does have 1. Drying function 2. Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. Instead, it has a 1/2 course that can be used when running a small amount! I can handle 3-4 dishes a day, so I'm satisfied because I can handle it every day without any burden. There's also a glass cup course that runs at low temperature, so it seems good for handling plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons 1. The noise is louder than I thought. It's about the same as the noise from a washing machine. They say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's the same level as the TV and the dishwasher. It's not a small noise that's buried in the TV. Instead, it has a reservation function, so I think I can run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble~ ----------> (After using it several times, I found that when I put in a small amount of dishes, the water stream hit the walls and ceiling, so it was loud, but on days when I put in a lot of dishes, it was quiet.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are wings only at the bottom and in the middle. But the cleaning power is good. 3. It was listed as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but it smells like a gas station when the drying function is on. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once but it was so bad that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it (if it were built-in, I would pay 30 more and buy the CUX Steam Shot). If you are looking for a 6-person dishwasher, I definitely recommend the 12-person one for the same price. If you are sensitive to Ascon issues, I don't recommend it. The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy thinking that it is doing the dishes for me. Wash the dishes that would take 30 minutes with a sore back, do the preliminary washing in 5 minutes and then rest. + The installer was very kind.

However, the price of 6-person went up from a few months ago, so Cuckoo was 400,000 won to Samsung 600,000 won. Up until then, I didn't even consider Media 6-person even though it was cheaper. I wanted to buy a familiar brand. I started looking into freestanding ones again, but Freestanding is 10-20 more expensive than built-in and doesn't have as many features as the latest models. I don't wash many dishes, so I thought this wasn't it because the price was going up more than my original budget, and I was considering a 6-person model again when I found a Media 12-person model on sale for 300,000 won! Since it's freestanding, you don't have to buy unnecessary storage and you can just install the dishwasher neatly, so there's no need to spend extra money! After looking for something that fits my needs for days, I was exhausted and when I found the Media 12-person model, it looked so good. It's cheaper than a 6-person model but has all the features? Reservation function 3. 1/2 course (a course that can replace partial washing) The LG 700,000 won model is an older model, so there is no drying function/reservation function. It's unfortunate, but it's LG~ I thought the Media wouldn't have it since it's in the 300,000 won range, but I reviewed it and it has a drying function. I thought it wouldn't have a reservation function~, but when I installed it, it had a reservation function. Also, since I'm a single-person household, it was burdensome to run a 12-person model every day, so I considered the Cuckoo 12-person model in the same price range with a partial washing function, but as expected, the built-in Media doesn't have a partial washing function. Instead, it has a 1/2 course that can be used when running a small amount! I can handle 3-4 dishes a day, so I'm satisfied because I can handle it every day without any burden. There's also a glass cup course that runs at low temperature, so it seems good for handling plastic lunch boxes and humidifier filters. Honest cons 1. The noise is louder than I thought. It's about the same as the noise from a washing machine. They say you can't hear it while watching TV, but it's the same level as the TV and the dishwasher. It's not a small noise that's buried in the TV. Instead, it has a reservation function, so I think I can run it in the morning and leave. If I had bought a different dishwasher without a reservation function, I would have been in big trouble~ ----------> (After using it several times, I found that when I put in a small amount of dishes, the water stream hit the walls and ceiling, so it was loud, but on days when I put in a lot of dishes, it was quiet.) 2. There are no wings on the ceiling. There are wings only at the bottom and in the middle. But the cleaning power is good. 3. It was listed as an advantage before, but the drying function is good, but it smells like a gas station when the drying function is on. Is this the asphalt smell? I used it once but it was so bad that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it (if it were built-in, I would pay 30 more and buy the CUX Steam Shot). The sound of the water in the dishwasher makes me happy thinking that it is doing the dishes for me. I used it once but it was so bad that I think I won't use the drying function in the future. Recommended vs. not recommended consumers. If you are looking for a cost-effective dishwasher and it doesn't have a built-in installation, I recommend it (if it were built-in, I would pay 30 more and buy the CUX Steam Shot). Sentence (English): This dishwasher gave us problems from the moment we plugged it in.
Comments (English): [ Should be $150 MAX ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher gave us problems from the moment we plugged it in. The power delivery board (where the power comes in from the wall) requires jiggling very regularly and has since we got it. A technician was sent out and "verified" that the dishwasher worked, stating there was nothing he could do. The soap dispensing door will occasionally fail to open during a wash cycle, requiring the dishwasher to be run again. The dish racks inside started to rust within 3 months of owning the device. The door feels like it could rip with very little effort. The gasket comes off all the time and requires reseating. The bottom dish rack comes off alignment nearly every time it is pulled out to empty the dishes. The silverware rack started to deteriorate within months of owning it. The entire appliance feels like it is built as a toy. There is no way I would ever recommend this dishwasher to anyone ever. I am going to have to solder the wiring to the power delivery board and replace parts on this machine every year. It's unconscionable that this device is sold as a home appliance. I would be surprised to get 5 years out it.

Sentence (English): This is a great dishwasher!
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.
