Sentence (English): I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.

This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.

The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.
Comments (Original): 좋은 식기세척기 이거네요~!!! 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 합리적인 가격과 강력한 세척력, 직관적인 사용성을 겸비한 제품으로, 3~4인 가족에게 특히 잘 맞는 가성비 좋은 식기세척기입니다. 실제로 사용해보니 생각 이상으로 만족도가 높았고, 왜 요즘 식기세척기를 ‘필수 가전’이라고 하는지 몸소 체감하게 됐습니다.가장 먼저 눈에 띄는 건 심플하고 모던한 디자인입니다. 스테인리스 느낌의 메탈릭한 외관은 주방 어디에 두어도 잘 어울리며, 군더더기 없는 전면부 디스플레이는 사용이 직관적입니다. 상단 터치 패널로 모든 조작을 간단히 할 수 있고, 다양한 세척 코스가 잘 구분되어 있어 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 작동할 수 있습니다.이 제품은 12인용 대용량 모델이라 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 세척할 수 있는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 특히 냄비, 후라이팬, 도마 등 부피가 큰 주방용품도 함께 넣을 수 있어서 설거지를 두세 번 나눠 해야 하는 번거로움이 없다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 내부 바스켓은 상·하단 2단 구조로 되어 있으며, 칼이나 국자, 수저 등은 별도로 분리된 공간에 깔끔하게 배치할 수 있어 공간 활용도 뛰어납니다.세척력도 기대 이상이었습니다. 국물 그릇이나 기름기 많은 프라이팬, 밥풀 말라붙은 공기 등도 세척 후 번쩍번쩍 깨끗하게 닦여 나왔고, 세제와 헹굼 보조제를 함께 사용할 경우 유리잔이나 스테인리스 식기는 광택이 살아있는 수준으로 마무리됩니다. 고온 살균 기능까지 탑재되어 있어 위생 면에서도 안심이 되며, 특히 유아 식기나 조리도구를 세척할 때 유용했습니다.소음 수준은 일반적인 세탁기보다 낮은 편이며, 밤에 돌려도 생활 소음 수준이라 크게 거슬리지 않았습니다. 에너지 효율도 만족스러운 수준이라 자주 사용해도 전기세 부담이 크지 않았고, 물 사용량도 일반 수세보다 훨씬 절약된다는 점에서 환경과 경제 모두를 고려한 제품이라고 할 수 있습니다.설치 측면에서도 특별한 어려움은 없었습니다. 기본 설치는 매우 간단하며, 수도 연결이 어려운 환경이라면 별도 설치 서비스나 이동식 배수통을 이용한 설치도 가능합니다. 단, 빌트인 설치가 아닌 프리스탠딩 형태이기 때문에 공간이 어느 정도 확보되어야 하며, 사전 측정이 중요합니다.마이디어는 중국 가전 대기업으로, 가성비 높은 제품군으로 유명한 브랜드입니다. 식기세척기의 경우에도 가격 대비 기능이 충실하고 실사용 만족도가 높아, 입문자용 혹은 예산에 맞춘 실속형 제품으로 매우 좋은 선택지입니다. 특히 타사 고가 모델 대비 몇십만 원 저렴한데도 세척력, 편의성, 소음 수준 등에서 큰 차이를 느끼지 못했다는 점이 인상적이었습니다.총평하자면, 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 ‘첫 식기세척기’로도, ‘가성비 중심의 실속형 모델’로도 탁월한 선택입니다. 공간만 충분히 확보된다면, 매일 설거지에 들이던 시간과 에너지를 절약하며 훨씬 여유 있는 주방 라이프를 경험할 수 있습니다. 요즘같이 위생과 시간 관리가 중요한 시대에 진심으로 추천드릴 수 있는 제품입니다.

The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three to four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neatly arranged knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is significantly lower than with a standard flush, demonstrating a product that considers both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it is a freestanding model rather than a built-in installation, a certain amount of space must be secured, and pre-measurement is important. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective product line. In the case of dishwashers, it is a very good choice for beginners or as a practical product that fits the budget, as it has a good function for the price and has high user satisfaction. I was particularly impressed that I did not notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise level despite it being several hundred thousand won cheaper than expensive models from other companies. In summary, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as a 'first dishwasher' or as a 'practical model that focuses on cost-effectiveness.' If you have enough space, you can save the time and energy spent on daily dishes and experience a much more leisurely kitchen life. In today's era where hygiene and time management are important, I can wholeheartedly recommend this product.
Comments (Original): 좋은 식기세척기 이거네요~!!! 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 합리적인 가격과 강력한 세척력, 직관적인 사용성을 겸비한 제품으로, 3~4인 가족에게 특히 잘 맞는 가성비 좋은 식기세척기입니다. 실제로 사용해보니 생각 이상으로 만족도가 높았고, 왜 요즘 식기세척기를 ‘필수 가전’이라고 하는지 몸소 체감하게 됐습니다.가장 먼저 눈에 띄는 건 심플하고 모던한 디자인입니다. 스테인리스 느낌의 메탈릭한 외관은 주방 어디에 두어도 잘 어울리며, 군더더기 없는 전면부 디스플레이는 사용이 직관적입니다. 상단 터치 패널로 모든 조작을 간단히 할 수 있고, 다양한 세척 코스가 잘 구분되어 있어 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 작동할 수 있습니다.이 제품은 12인용 대용량 모델이라 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 세척할 수 있는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 특히 냄비, 후라이팬, 도마 등 부피가 큰 주방용품도 함께 넣을 수 있어서 설거지를 두세 번 나눠 해야 하는 번거로움이 없다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 내부 바스켓은 상·하단 2단 구조로 되어 있으며, 칼이나 국자, 수저 등은 별도로 분리된 공간에 깔끔하게 배치할 수 있어 공간 활용도 뛰어납니다.세척력도 기대 이상이었습니다. 국물 그릇이나 기름기 많은 프라이팬, 밥풀 말라붙은 공기 등도 세척 후 번쩍번쩍 깨끗하게 닦여 나왔고, 세제와 헹굼 보조제를 함께 사용할 경우 유리잔이나 스테인리스 식기는 광택이 살아있는 수준으로 마무리됩니다. 고온 살균 기능까지 탑재되어 있어 위생 면에서도 안심이 되며, 특히 유아 식기나 조리도구를 세척할 때 유용했습니다.소음 수준은 일반적인 세탁기보다 낮은 편이며, 밤에 돌려도 생활 소음 수준이라 크게 거슬리지 않았습니다. 에너지 효율도 만족스러운 수준이라 자주 사용해도 전기세 부담이 크지 않았고, 물 사용량도 일반 수세보다 훨씬 절약된다는 점에서 환경과 경제 모두를 고려한 제품이라고 할 수 있습니다.설치 측면에서도 특별한 어려움은 없었습니다. 기본 설치는 매우 간단하며, 수도 연결이 어려운 환경이라면 별도 설치 서비스나 이동식 배수통을 이용한 설치도 가능합니다. 단, 빌트인 설치가 아닌 프리스탠딩 형태이기 때문에 공간이 어느 정도 확보되어야 하며, 사전 측정이 중요합니다.마이디어는 중국 가전 대기업으로, 가성비 높은 제품군으로 유명한 브랜드입니다. 식기세척기의 경우에도 가격 대비 기능이 충실하고 실사용 만족도가 높아, 입문자용 혹은 예산에 맞춘 실속형 제품으로 매우 좋은 선택지입니다. 특히 타사 고가 모델 대비 몇십만 원 저렴한데도 세척력, 편의성, 소음 수준 등에서 큰 차이를 느끼지 못했다는 점이 인상적이었습니다.총평하자면, 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 ‘첫 식기세척기’로도, ‘가성비 중심의 실속형 모델’로도 탁월한 선택입니다. 공간만 충분히 확보된다면, 매일 설거지에 들이던 시간과 에너지를 절약하며 훨씬 여유 있는 주방 라이프를 경험할 수 있습니다. 요즘같이 위생과 시간 관리가 중요한 시대에 진심으로 추천드릴 수 있는 제품입니다.

The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage because it can wash a lot of dishes at once. I especially appreciate that it can accommodate large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The washing power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. Sentence (English): This is a great dishwasher!
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.
Comments (Original): 좋은 식기세척기 이거네요~!!! 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 합리적인 가격과 강력한 세척력, 직관적인 사용성을 겸비한 제품으로, 3~4인 가족에게 특히 잘 맞는 가성비 좋은 식기세척기입니다. 실제로 사용해보니 생각 이상으로 만족도가 높았고, 왜 요즘 식기세척기를 ‘필수 가전’이라고 하는지 몸소 체감하게 됐습니다.가장 먼저 눈에 띄는 건 심플하고 모던한 디자인입니다. 스테인리스 느낌의 메탈릭한 외관은 주방 어디에 두어도 잘 어울리며, 군더더기 없는 전면부 디스플레이는 사용이 직관적입니다. 상단 터치 패널로 모든 조작을 간단히 할 수 있고, 다양한 세척 코스가 잘 구분되어 있어 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 작동할 수 있습니다.이 제품은 12인용 대용량 모델이라 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 세척할 수 있는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 특히 냄비, 후라이팬, 도마 등 부피가 큰 주방용품도 함께 넣을 수 있어서 설거지를 두세 번 나눠 해야 하는 번거로움이 없다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 내부 바스켓은 상·하단 2단 구조로 되어 있으며, 칼이나 국자, 수저 등은 별도로 분리된 공간에 깔끔하게 배치할 수 있어 공간 활용도 뛰어납니다.세척력도 기대 이상이었습니다. 국물 그릇이나 기름기 많은 프라이팬, 밥풀 말라붙은 공기 등도 세척 후 번쩍번쩍 깨끗하게 닦여 나왔고, 세제와 헹굼 보조제를 함께 사용할 경우 유리잔이나 스테인리스 식기는 광택이 살아있는 수준으로 마무리됩니다. 고온 살균 기능까지 탑재되어 있어 위생 면에서도 안심이 되며, 특히 유아 식기나 조리도구를 세척할 때 유용했습니다.소음 수준은 일반적인 세탁기보다 낮은 편이며, 밤에 돌려도 생활 소음 수준이라 크게 거슬리지 않았습니다. 에너지 효율도 만족스러운 수준이라 자주 사용해도 전기세 부담이 크지 않았고, 물 사용량도 일반 수세보다 훨씬 절약된다는 점에서 환경과 경제 모두를 고려한 제품이라고 할 수 있습니다.설치 측면에서도 특별한 어려움은 없었습니다. 기본 설치는 매우 간단하며, 수도 연결이 어려운 환경이라면 별도 설치 서비스나 이동식 배수통을 이용한 설치도 가능합니다. 단, 빌트인 설치가 아닌 프리스탠딩 형태이기 때문에 공간이 어느 정도 확보되어야 하며, 사전 측정이 중요합니다.마이디어는 중국 가전 대기업으로, 가성비 높은 제품군으로 유명한 브랜드입니다. 식기세척기의 경우에도 가격 대비 기능이 충실하고 실사용 만족도가 높아, 입문자용 혹은 예산에 맞춘 실속형 제품으로 매우 좋은 선택지입니다. 특히 타사 고가 모델 대비 몇십만 원 저렴한데도 세척력, 편의성, 소음 수준 등에서 큰 차이를 느끼지 못했다는 점이 인상적이었습니다.총평하자면, 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 ‘첫 식기세척기’로도, ‘가성비 중심의 실속형 모델’로도 탁월한 선택입니다. 공간만 충분히 확보된다면, 매일 설거지에 들이던 시간과 에너지를 절약하며 훨씬 여유 있는 주방 라이프를 경험할 수 있습니다. 요즘같이 위생과 시간 관리가 중요한 시대에 진심으로 추천드릴 수 있는 제품입니다.

The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.
Comments (Original): 좋은 식기세척기 이거네요~!!! 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 합리적인 가격과 강력한 세척력, 직관적인 사용성을 겸비한 제품으로, 3~4인 가족에게 특히 잘 맞는 가성비 좋은 식기세척기입니다. 실제로 사용해보니 생각 이상으로 만족도가 높았고, 왜 요즘 식기세척기를 ‘필수 가전’이라고 하는지 몸소 체감하게 됐습니다.가장 먼저 눈에 띄는 건 심플하고 모던한 디자인입니다. 스테인리스 느낌의 메탈릭한 외관은 주방 어디에 두어도 잘 어울리며, 군더더기 없는 전면부 디스플레이는 사용이 직관적입니다. 상단 터치 패널로 모든 조작을 간단히 할 수 있고, 다양한 세척 코스가 잘 구분되어 있어 처음 사용하는 사람도 어렵지 않게 작동할 수 있습니다.이 제품은 12인용 대용량 모델이라 한 번에 많은 양의 식기를 세척할 수 있는 점이 큰 장점입니다. 특히 냄비, 후라이팬, 도마 등 부피가 큰 주방용품도 함께 넣을 수 있어서 설거지를 두세 번 나눠 해야 하는 번거로움이 없다는 점이 마음에 들었습니다. 내부 바스켓은 상·하단 2단 구조로 되어 있으며, 칼이나 국자, 수저 등은 별도로 분리된 공간에 깔끔하게 배치할 수 있어 공간 활용도 뛰어납니다.세척력도 기대 이상이었습니다. 국물 그릇이나 기름기 많은 프라이팬, 밥풀 말라붙은 공기 등도 세척 후 번쩍번쩍 깨끗하게 닦여 나왔고, 세제와 헹굼 보조제를 함께 사용할 경우 유리잔이나 스테인리스 식기는 광택이 살아있는 수준으로 마무리됩니다. 고온 살균 기능까지 탑재되어 있어 위생 면에서도 안심이 되며, 특히 유아 식기나 조리도구를 세척할 때 유용했습니다.소음 수준은 일반적인 세탁기보다 낮은 편이며, 밤에 돌려도 생활 소음 수준이라 크게 거슬리지 않았습니다. 에너지 효율도 만족스러운 수준이라 자주 사용해도 전기세 부담이 크지 않았고, 물 사용량도 일반 수세보다 훨씬 절약된다는 점에서 환경과 경제 모두를 고려한 제품이라고 할 수 있습니다.설치 측면에서도 특별한 어려움은 없었습니다. 기본 설치는 매우 간단하며, 수도 연결이 어려운 환경이라면 별도 설치 서비스나 이동식 배수통을 이용한 설치도 가능합니다. 단, 빌트인 설치가 아닌 프리스탠딩 형태이기 때문에 공간이 어느 정도 확보되어야 하며, 사전 측정이 중요합니다.마이디어는 중국 가전 대기업으로, 가성비 높은 제품군으로 유명한 브랜드입니다. 식기세척기의 경우에도 가격 대비 기능이 충실하고 실사용 만족도가 높아, 입문자용 혹은 예산에 맞춘 실속형 제품으로 매우 좋은 선택지입니다. 특히 타사 고가 모델 대비 몇십만 원 저렴한데도 세척력, 편의성, 소음 수준 등에서 큰 차이를 느끼지 못했다는 점이 인상적이었습니다.총평하자면, 마이디어 12인용 식기세척기는 ‘첫 식기세척기’로도, ‘가성비 중심의 실속형 모델’로도 탁월한 선택입니다. 공간만 충분히 확보된다면, 매일 설거지에 들이던 시간과 에너지를 절약하며 훨씬 여유 있는 주방 라이프를 경험할 수 있습니다. 요즘같이 위생과 시간 관리가 중요한 시대에 진심으로 추천드릴 수 있는 제품입니다.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model.
Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. Installation itself was straightforward. Basic installation is simple, and if water access is difficult, separate installation services or a portable drain are available. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Comments (English): This is a great dishwasher! The Mydia 12-person dishwasher combines a reasonable price, powerful cleaning power, and intuitive usability, making it a great value dishwasher for a family of three or four. I was more than satisfied with it after using it, and I realized why dishwashers are considered essential appliances these days. The first thing that catches my eye is its simple, modern design. The stainless-steel metallic exterior blends in well with any kitchen, and the uncluttered front display is intuitive to use. The top touch panel makes all operations simple, and the various wash cycles are clearly organized, making it easy for even first-time users to operate. This large-capacity 12-person model is a major advantage, allowing you to wash a large amount of dishes at once. I especially appreciate the ability to store large kitchen items like pots, pans, and cutting boards, eliminating the hassle of washing dishes in two or three separate loads. The internal basket features a two-tiered structure, allowing for neat storage of knives, ladles, spoons, and other items in separate compartments, maximizing space utilization. The cleaning power also exceeded expectations. Soup bowls, greasy frying pans, and dried rice air were all cleaned to a sparkling clean finish. Using the detergent and rinse aid together left glassware and stainless steel dishes with a lustrous finish. The high-temperature sterilization function also ensures hygiene, making it particularly useful for washing baby dishes and cooking utensils. The noise level is lower than that of a typical washing machine, and even at night, it was quiet enough to be considered a daily noise level, which was not a major nuisance. Energy efficiency is also satisfactory, ensuring a low electricity bill even with frequent use. Water consumption is also significantly reduced compared to conventional flushing machines, demonstrating a product that prioritizes both the environment and economy. However, since it's a freestanding unit, not a built-in unit, you'll need to secure some space, and pre-measurement is crucial. Mydia is a major Chinese home appliance brand known for its cost-effective lineup. Their dishwashers offer a good balance of features and user satisfaction, making them a great choice for entry-level users or budget-conscious consumers. What's particularly impressive is that, despite costing hundreds of thousands of won less than other expensive models, I didn't notice a significant difference in cleaning power, convenience, or noise levels. Overall, the Mydia 12-person dishwasher is an excellent choice as both a first-time dishwasher and a value-for-money model. As long as you have enough space, you can save time and energy on daily dishwashing and enjoy a much more relaxed kitchen life. In today's world, where hygiene and time management are paramount, I wholeheartedly recommend this product.

Sentence (English): Over the years, I've likely installed and used over a dozen dishwashers.
Comments (English): [ Bosch is The Boss! ] || ---------------- || Over the years, I've likely installed and used over a dozen dishwashers. Some were 'builder grade', and some were considered high end at the time. I can safely say that none of them matched the looks, convenience, or versatility of my new Bosch 500 Series dishwasher.My unit arrived roughly a week ago without issue, and I spent the first couple of days unpacking and inspecting my dishwasher, reading the included manuals, and getting my old dishwasher removed. I did have a couple of questions prior to installation, and elected to email Bosch. Their responsiveness was outstanding--often within a half hour of my query--and they answered my questions fully. For example, the dishwasher arrived with a clear plastic film wrapping most of the front door, and it had been scuffed from the motion of the packing materials during the long drive. I was wondering if this film could be removed and the answer was that it could be peeled off if desired. I did so easily, leaving the stainless panel in pristine condition.The included Installation Manual is more than adequate and easy to follow. There are even QR codes scattered throughout which, when scanned with my phone, led to short videos showing the actual process in detail. The User Manual, however, is quite light and provides only enough information to get a person started. A much more comprehensive Use and Care Guide is available online. All of the manuals, as well as other useful information, are also available through the Bosch Home Connect App, which I will touch on below.At this point I proceeded through the installation steps without issue. Being able to adjust the rear foot using a screwdriver slot in the front was quite helpful in leveling the unit. The finished install left the dishwasher protruding from my cabinets by about an inch. I would have preferred it further back, but my floor tile height prevented it. Regardless, I was extremely pleased with the final result.I decided to run a short cycle with the dishwasher empty to clean the lines and surfaces, and check for leaks. Bosch includes a red indicator light that shines on the floor while the machine is running, and I quickly understood why. It's hard to relate just how quiet this dishwasher is without hearing it--or should I say *not* hearing it--for yourself. It's more akin to a sound machine one might have next to their bed at night. I never thought I'd consider the sound of a running dishwasher as 'pleasant', but here we are.Next, I began to explore a number of the design features that make the 500 Series dishwashers unique. These include the fold down tines and Zone Wash area on the bottom rack, the height adjustments available on the upper rack, and the truly versatile silverware drawer. In fact, I immediately found this drawer so useful for my knives, silverware, and cooking utensils that I removed the lower silverware basket.I prepared the dishwasher to do my first full load, and chose the Auto Cycle along with Auto Air. This opens the door a few inches at the end of the cycle to aid in drying. The results were excellent. The only issue I noticed was that my silverware had some streaking, which can be caused by excess rinse aid being used. I changed the setting from High to Low and that seems to have solved the problem.Finally, I installed the Bosch Home Connect app. There is an instruction sheet included with the manuals that details that process, and after going through a simple two step registration I was able to view and control my dishwasher via my phone. Using the app is not mandatory by any means, but it does open up another level of functionality and convenience that I can appreciate. The app allows fine grained control over the sorts of information that gets shared over the web, and what notifications are provided, if any. Using Home Connect, I was able to access cycles and options that were either not available or difficult to program via the top control panel. These include cycles like Eco or Half Load. And, the app allowed me to name my dishwasher. I am now the proud owner of 'The Plate Whisperer'! I can honestly say that the Bosch 500 Series dishwasher has exceeded all of my expectations. I look forward to enjoying it for years to come. Note that the dishwasher comes with a substantial 1 year/5 year limited warranty on workmanship and electronics, and a lifetime warranty on rust through. Also, a 30 day cosmetic warranty is also provided--something I've never seen before. Bosch is indeed The Boss.

Comments (English): +..++..++..++..++..++..++ Everyone was raving about the dishwasher aunt, so I went to look at it since I had surgery and was sick. So I waited until the dishwasher was done and opened it wide with my hand. The dishes were really hot when I touched them with my hand. It seemed to sterilize well, so I liked it! But. Compared to that, the drying power seems to be lacking. The drying function I thought was to have no moisture at all. In the case of the cutlery holder, water drips down even after a day when I shake it left and right. What about the cleaning power? Since I'm going to put it in after evaporating anyway. Sentence (English): We are very happy with our Series 500 dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Cleaner Dishes ] || ---------------- || We are very happy with our Series 500 dishwasher. Our first Bosch dishware lasted 15 years, and we extremely happy with the wash quality, even on the "Quick" setting. Well, our new dishwasher is noticeably better. We still use the quickest cycle available, and the dishes come our NOTICEABLY cleaner. We also like the fact that there is no need for a heating element to dry the dishes. We just leave the door closed for about 10 minutes after the cycle is done, open the door, and when the steam is gone, the dishes are dry. We are extremely satisfied and happy with our choice. And we really enjoy the 3rd row for silverware.

Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher With Some Unique Features ] || ---------------- || We've always had domestic dishwashers, starting with builder grade GE, then a Maytag, and most recently a KitchenAid. You get used to operating a dishwasher a certain way, but you certainly can't do that with our new top of the line Bosch. Our KitchenAid had 3 racks ala the Bosch, but also a heating element for drying. The Bosch uses a completely different drying approach. The total cycle takes longer now, but the results are . about the same. Pros: Top (3rd) rack is adjustable to allow a bit larger items than our KitchenAid could. The middle (2nd) rack is very flexible. The KitchenAid had two positions, both sides up or both sides down. The Bosch gives the flexibility to raise or lower the middle rack to any of 3 positions on either side. So you can have one side all the way up, and the other all the way down. That's a better feature than the KitchenAid, since now we can have a large pot on the bottom rack on one side, and shorter plates / dishes on the other side, and it's all good. Watch the videos for how to best use these features. Another pro, but an extra cost accessory, are the clips fastened to the middle rack, for holding small items. However, they hould be standard, not an accessory. We all have items that would benefit from that accessory. Cons: The cycle time is longer; however, there are flexible options. Downside, if you want everything spot free and dry, you have to leave your dishes in the dishwasher after the lengthy cycle ends. That's when the non-electrical drying feature really kicks in to absorb all that excess moisture. A 2nd con - when you are setting up your cycle, you have to close the dishwasher promptly after hitting the "go" button. If you don't, all the lights flash, and the unit doesn't start. You have to open the dishwasher, hit the "go" button again, and close it promptly. The 3rd design con - the silverware holding feature. The top (3rd) rack is really designed to hold silverware, and a very small basket is provided on the bottom rack. We are very used to a larger bottom rack basket for all of our silverware, and using the top rack for the oversized pieces. This unit isn't really designed for that. You can order an accessory basket and add a 2nd one, but why not just make it larger to begin with? Bottom line, a pretty good dishwasher, maybe a great one, but with a bit of a learning curve. For that reason, I deducted a star.

You get used to operating a dishwasher a certain way, but you certainly can't do that with our new top of the line Bosch. Our KitchenAid had 3 racks ala the Bosch, but also a heating element for drying. The Bosch uses a completely different drying approach. The total cycle takes longer now, but the results are . about the same. Pros: Top (3rd) rack is adjustable to allow a bit larger items than our KitchenAid could. The middle (2nd) rack is very flexible. The KitchenAid had two positions, both sides up or both sides down. The Bosch gives the flexibility to raise or lower the middle rack to any of 3 positions on either side. So you can have one side all the way up, and the other all the way down. That's a better feature than the KitchenAid, since now we can have a large pot on the bottom rack on one side, and shorter plates / dishes on the other side, and it's all good. Watch the videos for how to best use these features. Another pro, but an extra cost accessory, are the clips fastened to the middle rack, for holding small items. However, they hould be standard, not an accessory. We all have items that would benefit from that accessory. Cons: The cycle time is longer; however, there are flexible options. Downside, if you want everything spot free and dry, you have to leave your dishes in the dishwasher after the lengthy cycle ends. That's when the non-electrical drying feature really kicks in to absorb all that excess moisture. A 2nd con - when you are setting up your cycle, you have to close the dishwasher promptly after hitting the "go" button. If you don't, all the lights flash, and the unit doesn't start. You have to open the dishwasher, hit the "go" button again, and close it promptly. The 3rd design con - the silverware holding feature. The top (3rd) rack is really designed to hold silverware, and a very small basket is provided on the bottom rack. We are very used to a larger bottom rack basket for all of our silverware, and using the top rack for the oversized pieces. This unit isn't really designed for that. You can order an accessory basket and add a 2nd one, but why not just make it larger to begin with? Bottom line, a pretty good dishwasher, maybe a great one, but with a bit of a learning curve. For that reason, I deducted a star.

Loading is versatile if not a bit challenging because there are so many options. Overall, I'm very happy with this product.

Sentence (English): We've had this Samsung dishwasher model (dw80cg5450mt) for a little over 2 weeks now and we're starting to regret our purchase.
Comments (English): [ Buyer's remorse starting to kick in ] || ---------------- || We've had this Samsung dishwasher model (dw80cg5450mt) for a little over 2 weeks now and we're starting to regret our purchase. First, the dishes don't seem to be as clean as they were with our 20+ year old Kenmore that just kicked the bucket. Secondly, the drying feature called the AutoRelease Door is pretty much a joke when it comes to drying your dishes after a cycle. For example, last night we did a small load of dishes around 6:00 pm. When the cycle finished, the AutoRelease Door function kicked in and popped the door open to release steam and help the dishes air dry. The problem is that at 10:00 am this morning (16 hours later) when I started to take the dishes out to put away, everything (especially the silverware) was still wet. How does a $600+ dishwasher not have a better system for drying dishes? The third issue that we've found with this machine in its short time with us is that the filter clogs pretty quickly. We've done about 5 loads in the 2+ weeks we've had the machine and we've had standing water in the bottom of the unit one time already.This product came highly recommended by Best Buy customers which is partly what we based our purchase on. Boy, were we mislead.

Sentence (English): When we purchased this we knew that it was wifi capable.
Comments (English): [ Why does it need an app to operate? ] || ---------------- || When we purchased this we knew that it was wifi capable. We asked and were told that you didn't need the app to operate. But. when I went to use some features like delay or eco mode I found out that you needed the app to run these modes. That you have to use a mediocre app to run approximately half of the programs/cycles is just asinine. It would be easy enough to put those features in the menu on the dishwasher. Why didn't they do that? When getting the app to function you need to allow a bunch of different permissions on your phone to operate, I am not keen giving some random company all of these permissions. Also, I used the dishwasher a few days before I found this out so I was unable to return it. Had I know this I do not think I would have purchased this dishwasher. Other than that the dishwasher washes well. My previous dishwasher had the door open automatically when the cycles finished which was a wonderful feature. I don't see why this is not included on all dishwashers now.

Sentence (English): I bought the Bosch Series 6 dishwasher with energy efficiency class B a few weeks ago and have been very satisfied so far.
Comments (English): [ First class from Bosch, very very satisfied ] || ---------------- || I bought the Bosch Series 6 dishwasher with energy efficiency class B a few weeks ago and have been very satisfied so far. The dishwashing results are excellent – even dried-on food residue is reliably removed without the need for pre-rinsing. The machine is very quiet, which was particularly important to me since I have an open-plan kitchen. Even with a full load, the appliance operates efficiently and economically. The design is modern, and the workmanship is of high quality, as you would expect from Bosch. Another plus is the flexible interior concept: The foldable shelves and the height-adjustable drawer make loading much easier. This is really practical for families or couples who use the appliance regularly. The Home Connect app works perfectly – I can start the dishwashing cycle remotely or receive status updates directly on my smartphone. One small drawback: The Eco program takes a relatively long time, but that's normal for energy-efficient appliances. Overall, a top-notch appliance with good value for money!
Comments (Original): [ Erste klasse von Bosch, sehr sehr zu frieden ] || ---------------- || Ich habe den Bosch Geschirrspüler Serie 6 mit Energieeffizienzklasse B vor einigen Wochen gekauft und bin bisher sehr zufrieden. Die Spülergebnisse sind ausgezeichnet – selbst eingetrocknete Speisereste werden zuverlässig entfernt, ohne dass man vorspülen muss.Die Maschine ist sehr leise, was mir besonders wichtig war, da ich eine offene Küche habe. Auch bei voller Beladung arbeitet das Gerät effizient und sparsam. Das Design ist modern, und die Verarbeitung wirkt hochwertig, wie man es von Bosch erwartet.Ein weiteres Plus ist das flexible Innenraumkonzept: Die klappbaren Halterungen und die höhenverstellbare Schublade erleichtern das Einräumen erheblich. Für Familien oder Paare mit regelmäßigem Gebrauch ist das wirklich praktisch.Die Home Connect App funktioniert einwandfrei – ich kann den Spülvorgang aus der Ferne starten oder Statusmeldungen direkt auf mein Smartphone bekommen.Kleiner Nachteil: Das Eco-Programm dauert relativ lange, aber das ist bei energieeffizienten Geräten normal. Insgesamt ein Top-Gerät mit gutem Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis!

Sentence (English): Those with back pain will understand.
Comments (English): [ Those who suffer from back pain will understand. It is hard to bend over, so I don't use the built-in dishwasher much. I thought about it a lot. It wasn't an easy decision to buy a new dishwasher when I had one that was in good condition. ] || ---------------- || Those with back pain will understand. It’s hard to bend over, so I don’t use the built-in dishwasher much. I thought about it a lot. It wasn’t an easy decision to buy a new one when I already had a perfectly good dishwasher. I happened to see a live broadcast and bought it, and the size was just right for the sink. If the sink top is made of natural marble, an additional 100,000 won will be charged for the drilling. If you’re thinking about buying it, please note that there isn’t much of a difference in price from the cheaper 12-person model. After using it, I found that it holds less than I thought. I have to wash it right after a meal. It’s full if I put in a few dishes, a cup or two, and a plate or two. And it’s supposed to be about 80% dry, but the water is still there. I even used dishwasher rinse, but I don’t know what’s wrong, so I’m not very satisfied.
Comments (Original): [ 허리 아프신분들은 공감하실테지요.허리 숙이기 힘들어 빌트인 식세기를 잘 안쓰게 된다는걸요. 고민 많이했지요. 멀쩡히 있는 식세기를 두고 새로 산다는게 쉬운결정이 아니었어요. 우연히 ] || ---------------- || 허리 아프신분들은 공감하실테지요.허리 숙이기 힘들어 빌트인 식세기를 잘 안쓰게 된다는걸요. 고민 많이했지요. 멀쩡히 있는 식세기를 두고 새로 산다는게 쉬운결정이 아니었어요. 우연히 라방을 보다가 구입했는데 마침 씽크대위에 사이즈도 딱 맞았어요. 씽크대 상판이 천연대리석인집 타공비 10만원 추가됩니다. 이렇게되면 좀 저렴한 12인용과 가격면에서 큰 차이가 없으니 구매하실분들 참고하세요. 사용해본 결과 생각보다 적은 양이 들어가네요 한끼 식사후엔 바로 씻어야해요 그릇 몇개 컵 한두개 접시 한두개 넣으면 꽉 차요. 그리고 건조가 80프로 정도 된다는데 아니오 물이 거의 그대로 있어요. 식세기용 린스까지 사용했음에도 뭐가 잘못된건지 저는 만족도가 그리 높진않아요.

Sentence (English): I purchased the Cuckoo Marshmallow 2.0 dishwasher and am overall satisfied.
Comments (English): [ I purchased the Cuckoo Marshmallow 2.0 dishwasher and am overall satisfied with it. The overall design is cute and white, so I thought it was named that way because it looks like a marshmallow. It is for a single person and is not very big. ] || ---------------- || I purchased the Cuckoo Marshmallow 2.0 dishwasher and am overall satisfied. The overall design is cute, and the white color resembles a marshmallow, hence the name. I live alone in a small house, and it's a perfect size for my small kitchen. It takes up little space, so installation was a breeze. It's also convenient because it's a no-installation system, requiring no water connection, so you just fill the tank with water. I drink a lot of beverages, so I bought it for washing cups. It washes dishes thoroughly and is much more hygienic than hand washing. It's like a washing machine. It's quieter than I expected, so I can use it even at night without any problems. My only regret is that I wish it had a slightly larger capacity. I think it should be larger for a four- or five-person household, rather than a three-person one, to make it more convenient for a single-person household. Also, it still retains some moisture even after drying. You have to purchase a special detergent separately. If you use it vigorously, it foams up and creates a lot of mess. I bought it after a friend recommended it, and I'm very satisfied with its convenience. I can live without it, but I think it would make my life more convenient if I had it. I bought a Cuckoo food waste disposer and a Cuckoo rice cooker, and now I'm a Cuckoo fanatic, too, with a Cuckoo dishwasher. I highly recommend it for single-person households.

Optimized for small spaces, this is a crucial feature for those living alone. 2. Easy installation! It's a tank-type dishwasher, so it's perfect for single-room apartments! I'm always amazed at how clean it gets, even without pre-washing. It even has a drying function, so after washing, it dries fluffy, eliminating the need for a separate dishcloth. For someone like me who used to stress over the pile of dishes, this capacity has definitely improved my quality of life. Overall: A lifesaver for my studio apartment, it's a must-have! The Minix Mini Dishwasher PRO 3-person is the ultimate dishwasher for efficient use even in tight spaces. Its sleek design, easy installation, and, most importantly, its powerful cleaning power exceed my expectations! I highly recommend this to single-person households and those who, like me, struggle with dishwashing. I'm so happy I discovered this great product thanks to the Coupang Review Team. Now I don't have to worry about not eating because I have to do the dishes!
