Sentence (English): The dishwasher works just fine but our problem is with the design of the baskets.
Comments (English): [ Good machine but imperfect design. ] || ---------------- || The dishwasher works just fine but our problem is with the design of the baskets. Since all manufacturers evidently got rid of the in-door silverware option, we kept the lower basket from our previous Whirlpool dishwasher because it has hooks on the front so that the silverware basket can be hung there. We do not like how much space the silverware basket takes up in the newer models so we kept the lower one from the old machine. We would have done the same with the upper basket but it is not possible to detach it and replace it with the one from the older model. The upper basket on the older model is designed much better for our use and we don't like the way the new upper basket works out. We're making do but it's not as good. As for the top basket, we took it out altogether. With the top, flat, basket in place, we can't really adjust the height of the upper basket to accommodate our dishes. The reason we bought this newer model in the first place was because the motor on the older one gave out and it seemed reasonable that other components would fail in the near term. We are not happy about the shorter and shorter lives of appliances and these design flaws in the new one make us regret not having just fixed the older one. As I say, the new one operates very well but we are already resigned to the fact that we won't get the life out of it that we should be able to expect. Very disappointing.

It has some deeper ares that I can use for my dessert bowls, spoon rests, etc. If you are considering a new dishwasher please please check out this Whirlpool Eco Series Dishwasher…. you will not be disappointed in purchasing it! Excellent appliance!

Sentence (English): This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (English): [ #KitchenMiniLife #MutagongDishwasher ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been a housewife for 34 years now~~^^ This is my first dishwasher in my life. This was a great opportunity to purchase one, and it seems to be the perfect size for my husband and I, who live alone. When I first ordered it, I thought it would be quite small because it was advertised as a mini dishwasher, but when it arrived, it was actually bigger than I expected. The clean design and charcoal color are stain-resistant, which is nice. Best of all, it's a no-punch design, so anyone can install it without a technician, making it easy to use. The two-tier design allows you to wash large plates, rice, and soup bowls on the first tier, and smaller dishes and cutlery on the second. The interior size is relatively convenient for a family of two, allowing for efficient use of space. The mini dishwasher is ready to use by simply adding water to the water tank. The water sensor is built in to fill the water tank, so just fill it until the beep sounds. While the average water usage for a single hand wash is 100-120L, the Minix Mini dishwasher reportedly saves water by using only 5.5L. I personally used the Minix Mini dishwasher, and the standard wash time is about an hour. It's a bit noisy, but not so much that it's bothersome. The water flow is surprisingly powerful. Since it dries with hot air, be careful of the steam coming out of the drain. After washing, it can be used for general dish storage, making it ideal for studio apartments, officetels, or other small spaces. I used to do all the kitchen work myself. But after washing dishes by hand, using a dishwasher for the first time made me feel like a housewife. I will continue to be grateful to the dishwasher for its help in the kitchen. Note: When the product I received was first delivered, there was some moisture in the product. After reading the detailed description carefully, it was explained in detail that this was because some of the products are tested to ensure quality and function before shipping. When I read other people's reviews, I saw that some people misunderstood that the product was returned after seeing the moisture in the product. @ Please read the detailed description carefully. I wrote this honestly from the customer's perspective before being a member of the test group. I hope my review was of some help to those who are shopping. ^^

Comments (English): [ Escape from dishwashing hell ] || ---------------- || This review was written after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I finally got a "dishwasher lady" in my home! I used to think a dishwasher was a luxury for single- or two-person households, but now I understand why everyone says it "changes the quality of life." I'm so happy just to be free from the chore of washing dishes, but I'm also amazed every day by the beautiful design that complements my kitchen interior. Design and the convenience of "no installation": I'd been eyeing a dishwasher for some time. However, I hesitated because most models had a clunky design or seemed like a hassle to install. Drilling holes were especially out of the question. The Minix dishwasher solved all my worries. The luxurious "oatmeal beige" color blends seamlessly into my kitchen, and it feels like a beautiful object, not just a simple appliance. The "no installation" feature is the biggest advantage. There's no need to call a technician or do any construction work. Simply place it wherever you want and plug in the power cord. It was incredibly easy to install, as all you had to do was pour water directly into the inlet at the bottom of the appliance. Even those worried about frequent moves can use it without any worries. Cleaning power, drying, and peace of mind. Given the name "Mini," I didn't expect much from the cleaning power. But it far exceeded my expectations. Even the red seasoning and red pepper powder from the bowl of kimchi fried rice I had for dinner, and the greasy frying pan, were all cleaned squeaky clean on the standard setting, as if nothing had happened. The high-temperature water sterilization provided a sanitary and refreshing feeling that hand washing simply couldn't replicate. The finishing touch of the Minix dishwasher is its drying function. After each wash, it completely dries the dishes with hot air. This allows me to remove them and put them back in the cupboard without leaving any water stains, which is incredibly convenient. The UV sterilization function also provides peace of mind, ensuring hygienic storage without worrying about bacteria. It says it's for three people, but it's usually big enough to hold the dishes from one meal. If you stack the dishes in the evening and use the schedule function to run it at dawn, you can wake up to fluffy, warm dishes in the morning. The noise level is also surprisingly low, so it wasn't bothersome at all even though I was sleeping in the next room. I reflect on my past self who thought, "I can just wash a few dishes by hand." I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Sentence (English): I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life."
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Sentence (English): I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly?
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

잘 안 닦일까 봐 걱정했는데, 실제로 돌려보면 그런 걱정이 무색해질 만큼 깔끔하게 세척돼요. 유리컵에 생기던 희뿌연 물때도 없이 맑게 나오고, 프라이팬에 남은 기름기나 밥그릇에 눌어붙은 국물 자국도 전혀 남지 않아요. 내부에 상하 회전 노즐이 있어서 사방팔방으로 고압수를 뿌려주는 느낌이라 정말 구석구석까지 물이 잘 닿아요. 세제는 전용 식기세척기 캡슐도 써봤고, 액체형 세제도 써봤는데 두 제품 다 문제 없이 잘 작동했어요. 개인적으로는 캡슐형이 더 편하고 깔끔해서 추천드려요.  세척 모드도 다양하게 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있어요. 저는 대부분 표준모드로 사용하고 있고, 특히 기름기 많은 날은 강력모드로 돌려줘요. 세척시간은 30분~60분 내외로 짧지도 길지도 않아서 딱 적당하다고 느꼈어요.  세척 후에는 열풍건조 기능도 있어서 습기가 많은 그릇들도 어느 정도는 뽀송하게 말라요. 물론 완벽하게 100% 드라이되진 않지만, 유리컵이나 플라스틱 용기, 식판류는 거의 바로 꺼내서 정리할 수 있을 정도로 잘 말라요. 특히 통풍이 잘 되는 형태의 그릇이나 가벼운 접시류는 꺼낼 때 기분 좋을 만큼 바삭하게 건조돼요. 저는 문 열어놓고 추가 자연건조 하는데, 그 정도면 완벽합니다.  한 가지 꿀팁을 드리자면, 세척 전에는 큰 음식물 찌꺼기는 대충 털어서 넣는 게 좋아요. 물론 강력세척 모드 돌리면 거의 다 닦이긴 하지만, 음식물이 필터에 너무 많이 끼면 주기적으로 청소해줘야 하니까 귀찮잖아요. 저는 사용 끝난 뒤에 필터 한 번 빼서 물로 헹궈주는 걸 습관처럼 하고 있어요. 그거 하나만 잘 해줘도 위생적으로 오랫동안 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요.  정리하자면, ✅ 좁은 주방에도 들어가는 콤팩트한 사이즈 ✅ 자가급수형이라 어디서든 설치 가능 ✅ 고압 회전노즐로 세척력은 상상 이상 ✅ 세척모드 다양하고, 열풍건조까지 탑재 ✅ 물/전기 절약되고, 소음도 적당 ✅ 유리컵, 팬, 플라스틱, 스테인리스 등 대부분의 식기 OK  하루에도 몇 번씩 ‘아 진짜 잘 샀다’는 말이 절로 나와요. 혼자 사시는 분들, Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요. Sentence (English): The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

올려놔도 무리가 없고, 디자인도 깔끔하고 미니멀해서 인테리어에 전혀 방해가 안 돼요. 흰색 바디에 반투명 도어가 있어서 안에 세척되는 모습도 은근히 보는 재미가 있고요.  제가 선택한 모델은 자가급수형이에요. 수도 연결형도 있지만, 자가급수형은 말 그대로 위에 있는 물통에 물만 부어주면 알아서 세척되니까, 싱크대 구조 상 배수나 수도 연결이 어려운 분들에겐 잘 안 닦일까 봐 걱정했는데, 실제로 돌려보면 그런 걱정이 무색해질 만큼 깔끔하게 세척돼요. 유리컵에 생기던 희뿌연 물때도 없이 맑게 나오고, 프라이팬에 남은 기름기나 밥그릇에 눌어붙은 국물 자국도 전혀 남지 않아요. 내부에 상하 회전 노즐이 있어서 사방팔방으로 고압수를 뿌려주는 느낌이라 정말 구석구석까지 물이 잘 닿아요. 세제는 전용 식기세척기 캡슐도 써봤고, 액체형 세제도 써봤는데 두 제품 다 문제 없이 잘 작동했어요. 개인적으로는 캡슐형이 더 편하고 깔끔해서 추천드려요.  세척 모드도 다양하게 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있어요. 저는 대부분 표준모드로 사용하고 있고, 특히 기름기 많은 날은 강력모드로 돌려줘요. 세척시간은 30분~60분 내외로 짧지도 길지도 않아서 딱 적당하다고 느꼈어요.  세척 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요. But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Sentence (English): Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

올려놔도 무리가 없고, 디자인도 깔끔하고 미니멀해서 인테리어에 전혀 방해가 안 돼요. 흰색 바디에 반투명 도어가 있어서 안에 세척되는 모습도 은근히 보는 재미가 있고요.  제가 선택한 모델은 자가급수형이에요. 수도 연결형도 있지만, 자가급수형은 말 그대로 위에 있는 물통에 물만 부어주면 알아서 세척되니까, 싱크대 구조 상 배수나 수도 연결이 어려운 분들에겐 훨씬 편리해요. 물도 하루에 2~3번 돌린다 해도 10리터 내외라 부담이 적고, 배수는 호스를 그냥 싱크대에 살짝 걸어두면 돼서 따로 배관 설치도 필요 없어요. 저는 설치까지 포함해서 모든 세팅을 15분 안에 끝냈습니다. 박스에서 꺼내자마자 바로 사용 가능한 수준이에요.  가장 중요한 세척력, 진심으로 기대 이상이었어요. 처음에는 기름기 많은 그릇이나 팬은 잘 안 닦일까 봐 걱정했는데, 실제로 돌려보면 그런 걱정이 무색해질 만큼 깔끔하게 세척돼요. 유리컵에 생기던 희뿌연 물때도 없이 맑게 나오고, 프라이팬에 남은 기름기나 밥그릇에 눌어붙은 국물 자국도 전혀 남지 않아요. 내부에 상하 회전 노즐이 있어서 사방팔방으로 고압수를 뿌려주는 느낌이라 정말 구석구석까지 물이 잘 닿아요. 세제는 전용 식기세척기 캡슐도 써봤고, 액체형 세제도 써봤는데 두 제품 다 문제 없이 잘 작동했어요. 개인적으로는 캡슐형이 더 편하고 깔끔해서 추천드려요.  세척 모드도 다양하게 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있어요. 저는 대부분 표준모드로 사용하고 있고, 특히 기름기 많은 날은 강력모드로 돌려줘요. 세척시간은 30분~60분 내외로 짧지도 길지도 않아서 딱 적당하다고 느꼈어요.  세척 후에는 열풍건조 기능도 있어서 습기가 많은 그릇들도 어느 정도는 뽀송하게 말라요. 물론 완벽하게 100% 드라이되진 않지만, 유리컵이나 플라스틱 용기, 식판류는 거의 바로 꺼내서 정리할 수 있을 정도로 잘 말라요. 특히 통풍이 잘 되는 형태의 그릇이나 가벼운 접시류는 꺼낼 때 기분 좋을 만큼 바삭하게 건조돼요. 저는 문 열어놓고 추가 자연건조 하는데, 그 정도면 완벽합니다.  한 가지 꿀팁을 드리자면, 세척 전에는 큰 음식물 찌꺼기는 대충 털어서 넣는 게 좋아요. 물론 강력세척 모드 돌리면 거의 다 닦이긴 하지만, 음식물이 필터에 너무 많이 끼면 주기적으로 청소해줘야 하니까 귀찮잖아요. 저는 사용 끝난 뒤에 필터 한 번 빼서 물로 헹궈주는 걸 습관처럼 하고 있어요. 그거 하나만 잘 해줘도 위생적으로 오랫동안 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요.  정리하자면, ✅ 좁은 주방에도 들어가는 콤팩트한 사이즈 ✅ 자가급수형이라 어디서든 설치 가능 ✅ 고압 회전노즐로 세척력은 상상 이상 ✅ 세척모드 다양하고, 열풍건조까지 탑재 ✅ 물/전기 절약되고, 소음도 적당 ✅ 유리컵, 팬, 플라스틱, 스테인리스 등 대부분의 식기 OK  하루에도 몇 번씩 ‘아 진짜 잘 샀다’는 말이 절로 나와요. 혼자 사시는 분들, 설거지 싫어하는 분들, 주방 좁아서 망설였던 분들께 꼭 추천드리고 싶어요. 요즘은 진짜 일부러라도 컵 쓰고 그릇 꺼내 쓰게 될 정도로 삶의 질이 달라졌어요. 미닉스 미니 식기세척기, 고민만 하신다면 진짜 늦기 전에 들이세요. 저는 100% 만족하고 사용 중입니다.

Sentence (English): The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.
Comments (Original): 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.  미닉스 미니 식기세척기를 구매해서 사용한 지 일주일 정도 됐는데, 이건 정말 ‘생활의 질’이라는 게 뭔지 몸소 느끼게 해준 제품이에요. 사실 구매 전까지는 미니 식기세척기라는 게 얼마나 효과가 있을지 반신반의했어요. 공간 차지도 클 것 같고, 물도 많이 먹을 것 같고, 무엇보다 ‘진짜 잘 닦일까?’ 싶었죠. 그런데 직접 써보니까 이건 말 그대로 필수 가전템이었습니다.  우선 저는 1인 가구고, 주방이 좁은 편이라 식기세척기를 두는 게 굉장히 부담스러웠어요. 그런데 미닉스는 ‘미니’라는 이름답게 정말 작고 슬림해서 좁은 공간에도 쏙 들어가더라고요. 가로폭이 일반 전자레인지보다 약간 더 넓은 정도라 상부장 아래에 올려놔도 무리가 없고, 디자인도 깔끔하고 미니멀해서 인테리어에 전혀 방해가 안 돼요. 흰색 바디에 반투명 도어가 있어서 안에 세척되는 모습도 은근히 보는 재미가 있고요.  제가 선택한 모델은 자가급수형이에요. 수도 연결형도 있지만, 자가급수형은 말 그대로 위에 있는 물통에 물만 부어주면 알아서 세척되니까, 싱크대 구조 상 배수나 수도 연결이 어려운 분들에겐 잘 안 닦일까 봐 걱정했는데, 실제로 돌려보면 그런 걱정이 무색해질 만큼 깔끔하게 세척돼요. 유리컵에 생기던 희뿌연 물때도 없이 맑게 나오고, 프라이팬에 남은 기름기나 밥그릇에 눌어붙은 국물 자국도 전혀 남지 않아요. 내부에 상하 회전 노즐이 있어서 사방팔방으로 고압수를 뿌려주는 느낌이라 정말 구석구석까지 물이 잘 닿아요. 세제는 전용 식기세척기 캡슐도 써봤고, 액체형 세제도 써봤는데 두 제품 다 문제 없이 잘 작동했어요. 개인적으로는 캡슐형이 더 편하고 깔끔해서 추천드려요.  세척 모드도 다양하게 있어서 상황에 맞게 선택할 수 있어요. 저는 대부분 표준모드로 사용하고 있고, 특히 기름기 많은 날은 강력모드로 돌려줘요. 세척시간은 30분~60분 내외로 짧지도 길지도 않아서 딱 적당하다고 느꼈어요.  세척 후에는 열풍건조 기능도 있어서 습기가 많은 그릇들도 어느 정도는 뽀송하게 말라요. 물론 완벽하게 100% 드라이되진 않지만, 유리컵이나 플라스틱 용기, 식판류는 거의 바로 꺼내서 정리할 수 있을 정도로 잘 말라요. 특히 통풍이 잘 되는 형태의 그릇이나 가벼운 접시류는 꺼낼 때 기분 좋을 만큼 바삭하게 건조돼요. 저는 문 열어놓고 추가 자연건조 하는데, 그 정도면 완벽합니다.  한 가지 꿀팁을 드리자면, 세척 전에는 큰 음식물 찌꺼기는 대충 털어서 넣는 게 좋아요. 물론 강력세척 모드 돌리면 거의 다 닦이긴 하지만, 음식물이 필터에 너무 많이 끼면 주기적으로 청소해줘야 하니까 귀찮잖아요. 저는 사용 끝난 뒤에 필터 한 번 빼서 물로 헹궈주는 걸 습관처럼 하고 있어요. 그거 하나만 잘 해줘도 위생적으로 오랫동안 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요.  정리하자면, ✅ 좁은 주방에도 들어가는 콤팩트한 사이즈 ✅ 자가급수형이라 어디서든 설치 가능 ✅ 고압 회전노즐로 세척력은 상상 이상 ✅ 세척모드 다양하고, 열풍건조까지 탑재 ✅ 물/전기 절약되고, 소음도 적당 ✅ 유리컵, 팬, 플라스틱, 스테인리스 등 대부분의 식기 OK  하루에도 몇 번씩 ‘아 진짜 잘 샀다’는 말이 절로 나와요. 혼자 사시는 분들, Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

후에는 열풍건조 기능도 있어서 습기가 많은 그릇들도 어느 정도는 뽀송하게 말라요. 물론 완벽하게 100% 드라이되진 않지만, 유리컵이나 플라스틱 용기, 식판류는 거의 바로 꺼내서 정리할 수 있을 정도로 잘 말라요. 특히 통풍이 잘 되는 형태의 그릇이나 가벼운 접시류는 꺼낼 때 기분 좋을 만큼 바삭하게 건조돼요. 저는 문 열어놓고 추가 자연건조 하는데, 그 정도면 완벽합니다.  한 가지 꿀팁을 드리자면, 세척 전에는 큰 음식물 찌꺼기는 대충 털어서 넣는 게 좋아요. 물론 강력세척 모드 돌리면 거의 다 닦이긴 하지만, 음식물이 필터에 너무 많이 끼면 주기적으로 청소해줘야 하니까 귀찮잖아요. 저는 사용 끝난 뒤에 필터 한 번 빼서 물로 헹궈주는 걸 습관처럼 하고 있어요. 그거 하나만 잘 해줘도 위생적으로 오랫동안 사용할 수 있을 것 같아요.  소음 부분도 얘기해야죠. 처음엔 혹시 시끄러울까 봐 걱정했는데, 생각보다 훨씬 조용해요. 물론 완전 무소음은 아니지만, 세탁기 돌아가는 정도의 ‘부드러운 물 소리’ 정도라 밤에도 충분히 사용할 수 있어요. 저는 집에서 재택근무하면서 옆에서 돌리는데 전혀 방해되지 않았고, 심지어 책 읽거나 영상 보는 데도 거슬리지 않더라고요. Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Sentence (English): One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps.
Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life." Before purchasing, I was skeptical about the effectiveness of a mini dishwasher. I thought it would take up a lot of space, use a lot of water, and most importantly, would it really clean properly? But after using it myself, I realized it was a truly essential appliance. First of all, I live alone, and my kitchen is quite small, so having a dishwasher was a huge burden. However, the Minix lives up to its name, being incredibly small and slim. It's only slightly wider than a standard microwave, so it fits comfortably under a cabinet. Its clean, minimalist design doesn't distract from my interior at all. The white body and translucent door offer a subtle visual delight, as you can see the dishwasher being washed. The model I chose is the self-priming model. While there are plumbing-connected models, the self-priming model literally cleans itself by simply pouring water into the tank above, making it much more convenient for those with sinks that don't have drain or plumbing connections. Even if you only run the water two or three times a day, it only needs to hold about 10 liters, which is a small burden. Draining is accomplished by simply hanging the hose over the sink, eliminating the need for separate plumbing. I completed the entire setup, including installation, in less than 15 minutes. It's ready to use right out of the box. Most importantly, the cleaning power truly exceeded my expectations. At first, I was worried it wouldn't clean greasy dishes or pans well, but once I actually used it, those worries were quickly put to rest. The water came out clear, without any of the white stains that used to form on glass cups, and there was no trace of grease left on frying pans or soup stains on rice bowls. The internal rotating nozzle sprays high-pressure water in all directions, ensuring water reaches every nook and cranny. I've used both dishwasher capsules and liquid detergent, and both worked flawlessly. Personally, I recommend the capsules because they're easier and cleaner. They also have a variety of wash modes, so you can choose the one that best suits your needs. I usually use the standard mode, but on particularly oily days, I'll switch to the heavy-duty mode. The wash time is about 30 to 60 minutes, which is just right. After washing, the dishwasher has a hot air drying function, so even damp dishes are dried to a certain degree. While they're not 100% dry, glass cups, plastic containers, and plates are dry enough to be taken out and put away almost immediately. Especially for well-ventilated dishes and light plates, they're pleasantly crisp when taken out. I leave the door open and let them air dry for an additional hour, and that's perfect. One tip: before washing, it's a good idea to shake out any large food scraps. Of course, the powerful wash mode will clean most of it, but if food gets stuck in the filter, it needs to be cleaned regularly, which is a hassle. I make it a habit to remove the filter and rinse it with water after each use. Just doing that one thing will keep it hygienic for a long time. Let's also talk about noise. At first, I was worried it might be noisy, but it's much quieter than I expected. It's not completely silent, of course, but it's about the same level of "soft water noise" as a washing machine, so I can use it even at night. I work from home and have it running next to me without any disturbance, and it wasn't even bothersome when I was reading or watching a video. In short, it's compact enough to fit even in a small kitchen. It's self-priming, so it can be installed anywhere. The high-pressure rotating nozzle delivers incredible cleaning power, and it has a variety of cleaning modes, including hot air drying, which saves water and electricity, and the noise level is reasonable. It's suitable for most dishes, including glass cups, pans, plastic, and stainless steel. I find myself saying, "Wow, this was a great purchase!" several times a day. I highly recommend this to those who live alone, those who hate doing dishes, and those who hesitated because their kitchens are too small. These days, my quality of life has changed so much that I'm even willing to use cups and dishes. If you're considering the Minix Mini dishwasher, get it now before it's too late. I'm 100% satisfied with it.

Comments (English): This is a review I wrote after receiving a free product as part of a Coupang Experience Group event. I've been using the Minix Mini dishwasher for about a week now, and it truly has made me realize the true meaning of "quality of life."
